title: THREE TANKERS
HIT NEAR HORMUZ
leads.body: Projectiles hit two tankers leaving the Gulf. Iran says a third ship struck a mine east of the strait.

title: COP31 SPLITS
ON FOSSIL FUELS
leads.body: The EU and Pacific islands press for fossil fuel cuts. African negotiators seek more money for adaptation.

title: RIEMANN PROOF
PASSES CHECKS
leads.body: Independent tools verify the Lean proof of a conjecture about prime numbers first posed in 1859.

desk: Nations fail to set treaty talks
Three men killed in Israeli strike.
Sparta II drifts into Finnish waters.
At least four dead and 35 injured.
briefs: Magnitude 6.8 near Timor-Leste
USGS locates the quake northeast of Lospalos.
Aoun urges Israeli withdrawal
He also urges Hezbollah to give up its arms.
Rutte backs Poland in Warsaw
NATO chief condemns Friday’s airspace breach.
FBI investigates possible database breach
Reports point to the national crime database.
India’s Congress youth wing releases video
Footage shows Friday’s protests at Meta offices.
Magnitude 6.7 in Peru’s Andes
The quake struck at 7:09 p.m. Friday local time.
African football backs Infantino
CAF chief says all 54 members back his bid.
Ukraine defends Crimea bridge strikes
Zelensky calls the strikes a response to attacks.
Australia wins T20 opener
England beaten by three wickets in Melbourne.
Alcaraz reaches Turin final
He beats Ben Shelton in a third-set tiebreak.
footer: 21 November in UTC. Peru’s quake and the Sinaloa arrest fell on Friday evening locally. Edition closed at 20:40 UTC.
Reporting: AP, BBC, Reuters, Al Jazeera, The Guardian and Prothom Alo. Data: USGS, Lean community and Coinbase Exchange.
